messages:
alex.dev: Hey team — after the key rotation this morning our prod calls are getting 401 invalid_api_key. Started right after CI updated REDWOOD_API_KEY. curl shows header present but still 401. Anyone seen this?

maya.support: thanks for the report. can you paste a sanitized version of the Authorization header (first/last ~8 chars) and which CI secret you updated? :eyes:

alex.dev: sure — header (sanitized): Authorization: ApiKey abcd1234efgh5678,ijkl9012mnop3456
 also we updated the org-secret named infra/redwood/api-key in gitlab-ci.

maya.support: that looks like two keys concatenated with a comma — Redwood expects a single ApiKey token. if two values were accidentally merged the auth check will fail with 401.

liam.sre: quick tech note: our auth matcher does exact match against the single token stored; we trim whitespace/newlines but we don't split on commas or semicolons. double-key strings will never match and show up as invalid_api_key.

alex.dev: repro steps I ran locally to confirm:
```bash
export REDWOOD_API_KEY="abcd1234efgh5678,ijkl9012mnop3456"
curl -i -H "Authorization: ApiKey $REDWOOD_API_KEY" https://api.redwood.example.com/v1/generate
# --> HTTP/1.1 401 {"error":"invalid_api_key"}
```
removing the comma and using only the new key fixed it immediately.

maya.support: ok great root cause identified (secret got concatenated during CI secret rotation). steps to remediate: 1) replace infra/redwood/api-key value in CI with the single new token, 2) redeploy any jobs that pulled the bad secret, 3) rotate if you want to invalidate the old combined blob.

liam.sre: i'll add a note to our CI runbooks and follow up with a small guard in the support docs recommending a quick sanity check (length + disallowed delimiters) for API key envs. not planning an immediate platform change, but we can add telemetry to flag headers containing commas/semicolons to help triage.

maya.support: created internal ticket SUP-12345 to track doc + CI checklist updates. alex.dev: want us to validate your updated secret after you push?

alex.dev: please — i'll update now and ping when done. thanks! :raised_hands:

support-bot: Ticket SUP-12345 created and assigned to liam.sre.
